node.title: Re^3: how to extract original string from binary files?
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Hi Swapnil,

For various reasons I think it's best to just continue working via this site, that way everyone can learn from this thread. I already mentioned two ways you can convert your binary data to a format you can post here, to add more examples to that list there's [id://132401] in pure Perl and [google://windows hexdump|various Windows] tools available.

However, posting your binary data here won't help much if we don't know what format the file is in - the file format is actually much more important than the binary data. I see you've tried to describe it in the root node, but it's difficult to read, try using tags.

Regards,
-- Hauke D
